root_cause_summary: Redis worker concurrency saturation under high-volume burst ingestion.

timeline_events.event: Batch upload of 500 documents initiated via bulk API endpoint.
Redis queue depth exceeded 300 tasks threshold; latency warning triggered.
Auto-remediation engine triggered worker scaling from 4 to 8 replicas.
8 worker replicas actively consuming tasks; processing rate reached 450 tasks/min.
Queue backlog completely drained (depth = 12); P95 latency normalized to 142ms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transient ingestion surge exceeded baseline worker concurrency capacity.
evidence_telemetry: Redis queue metric spike from 10 to 450 tasks at 08:11:50Z
CPU load on worker instances peaked at 82%
No database deadlocks or network packet drops recorded

hypotheses.hypothesis: Slow database insertion locks causing worker backpressure.
evidence_telemetry: DB commit latency remained constant at 4.2ms throughout event

recommended_preventative_actions: Adjust default worker auto-scaling baseline from 4 to 6 replicas during peak business hours.
Implement client-side burst rate limiting on bulk document ingestion endpoints.
Enable proactive predictive scaling based on incoming upload webhook volume.
